_meta.description: Machine-readable TC-S Network system manifest for external orchestrators. Does NOT expose secrets or internal database structure.
_meta.note: Runtime values are served at GET /api/uim/system. This file contains the static schema reference.

system.name: TC-S Network
system.description: The Current See Network — Solar-powered distributed digital economy

POST /api/uim/invoke.description: Invoke a single capability through Policy → Executor pipeline

GET /api/uim/requests/:id/status.description: Poll the status of an action request by request_id

GET /api/uim/network-knowledge.description: Query the Learning Layer's derived knowledge. Filter by knowledge_type=CAPABILITY_METRICS for performance observations.

GET /api/uim/system.description: Sanitized runtime manifest — component status, supported workflows, live capability count

GET /api/uim/orchestrator-readiness.description: Reports whether all interfaces are up and the Network is ready for an external orchestrator

POST /api/uim/plan/validate.description: Dry-run plan validator. Accepts ORCHESTRATION_PLAN_V1. ZERO MUTATIONS. Returns capability resolution, risk estimate, approval requirements, blocked actions.

GET /api/uim/workflow-runs/:id.description: Observe a completed workflow run: steps, status, provenance, audit trail

ORCHESTRATION_TASK_V1.description: Network intent envelope from external orchestrator

ORCHESTRATION_PLAN_V1.description: Ordered capability execution plan. ONE workflow_run_id → MANY request_ids.

invariants.policy_engine: All capability invocations pass through Policy Engine. No bypass.
invariants.ledger_authority: The database/ledger is the authoritative Network state. External callers cannot write directly.
invariants.capability_authority: Capability definitions are static registry entries. Learning cannot change risk_level, permissions, or policy.
invariants.orchestrator_boundary: External orchestrators DISCOVER, PLAN, INVOKE, OBSERVE. They do not control the Network.
invariants.physical_boundary: No physical execution without explicit era-level approval.
